Then scan the smart devices in the living_room, send me the scan result as a high-priority app alert, set light_living brightness to 70, and unlock lock_main by setting it to unlock with PIN 2026. Finally, find Alice’s contact details, prepare and send her an email to alice with the subject “Meeting room confirmed” and the message “Your meeting room is booked and the room setup is ready.” Then get the latest business news in the business category and return the first headline.
